jobs.title: Overnight Armed Guard
jobs.description:
ARMED GUARD - OVERNIGHT SHIFTS - WEEKEND SHIFTS - FLEX SECURITY GUARD -

Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Armed Guard to join our security team. In this dynamic role, you will be responsible for safeguarding personnel, property, and assets through active surveillance, access control, and emergency response. Your expertise in law enforcement procedures, firearm handling, and conflict management will ensure a secure environment while providing excellent customer service to visitors and staff alike. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security skills in a fast-paced setting, contributing to the safety and well-being of everyone on site.

Experience

  • Proven experience in security roles, law enforcement, military service or related fields demonstrating strong surveillance capabilities and physical security expertise
  • Knowledge of incident report writing and emergency response procedures
  • Training in first aid, CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), AED operation, fire safety protocols, and conflict de-escalation techniques
  • Familiarity with firearm handling, Tasers, and other security equipment required for armed security positions
  • Excellent customer service skills with the ability to manage tense situations professionally while maintaining a positive attitude

Join us in creating a safe environment where safety is paramount! This role offers the chance to utilize your specialized skills in a rewarding setting that values proactive security measures and exceptional service. We are committed to supporting your growth as a security professional while ensuring your well-being through comprehensive training and resources.

Pay: From $17.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Brand Security Officer
At Tiffany, we expect our employees to deliver the Tiffany Experience to each customer and Tiffany is committed to creating an organization that recognizes and rewards excellence in service of this promise. The Brand Security Officer must be able to think strategically while also being hands-on in overseeing the day-to-day execution of the agreed upon strategy with a focus on clients, people and brand desirability. They will be open and approachable and will work with both the central team and the local teams in a transparent, united and mutually supportive manner. Be Creative & Innovative, Deliver Excellence and Cultivate an Entrepreneurial Spirit.
As a Tiffany Branch Security Officer, you will:
Security Controls and Operations:

Provide exceptional security and operations support to drive sales and service.
Partner with Senior Security Officer and Management to deter theft, report missing assets, respond to emergency situations and implement Incident Management Programs procedures.
Ensure security systems and procedures are adhered to by following up on daily inspections, equipment, alarm tests, inspections, key access, and report submissions.
Carry out operations tasks including opening and closing procedures. Assist with facilities repairs and communicate with store team.
Cover both security and back of house operations and controls.
Act as a Tiffany ambassador and carry out store operations to support the store in consistently achieving sales plan.
Demonstrate passion as a Tiffany brand ambassador during every customer interaction. Carry out operations tasks including opening and closing procedures. Assist with facilities repairs and connect with store team.
High School Graduate.
Basic computer skills.
Ability to work retail store hours as necessary, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Experience in a retail/security environment.
~1-year prior experience in a security related position.

Tiffany & Co. is formed from many facets - talented people who make our community stronger with their creativity, perspective, and lived experience. We believe reaching your full potential requires a solid foundation, and your well-being is a central pillar. Tiffany employees are eligible for comprehensive benefits, including global benefits like adoption and surrogacy assistance, and parental leave, as well as programs that support mental, emotional, physical, and financial well-being. We also offer competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plans with company match, paid time off, alongside other meaningful employee offerings.

jobs.title: Overnight Security Officer, Full-Time
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for assisting with the protection of property and assets, including employee through responding to Fire, medical, and other emergencies on campus; in addition to enforcing the polices as directed by management and/or employee handbook. This role is critical to maintaining the luxury standard and reputation of The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa while upholding the highest levels of discretion and professionalism.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
  • Physical patrols of the campus buildings garages and surface lots
  • Directing traffic as needed on campus
  • Responding to Fire, medical and other emergencies on campus
  • Maintenance of the Guest Room Safes, Golf cart and other Loss Prevention equipment
  • Maintenance of First Aid Equipment, including all kits and Automatic External Defibrillators
KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
  • High school education, GED, or equivalent experience
  • Must have 1-4 years previous security experience
  • Must have proficient technology skills with POS systems
  • Hours required: Scheduled days and hours vary based on departmental needs

LICENSES AND/OR CERTIFICATIONS
  • CPR/AED a plus
PHYSICAL JOB REQUIREMENTS
Must be able to meet the following minimum physical requirements for at least an eight-hour shift:
  • Physical Stamina: Frequent standing, walking, climbing of ladders and stairs, kneeling, reaching overhead, lifting and carrying various objects weighing up to 30 lbs. Must be able to work safely and effectively in outdoor temperatures. Summer temperatures outside can get above 95 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 months of year. For 2 months of year, low temperatures can get below 20 degrees Fahrenheit. Must be able to swim.
  • Hearing / Speech: Must be able to effectively engage in one-on-one communication with guests, members, and customers and use a 2-way radio to communicate clearly and accurately with co-workers.
  • Vision: Must be able to accurately read instructions, reports, and log sheets. Must be able to work with computers and PDAs in varying light conditions.
  • Literacy: Must be able to produce, read and understand reports, including security, incident and police reports. Must be able to analyze and process written information from a variety of sources and effectively communicate content of reports.
  • Chemicals/Agents: Must be able to work safely with chemicals according to SDS sheets and all applicable laws, codes and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Campus Security Officer - Night & Weekend Shifts
jobs.company: The Chronicle of Higher Education, Inc.
jobs.description:
Department: Police Salary: Commensurate with Experience/Education

Description: Provides physical security for a university building. Pursuant to the State of Texas Executive Order No. GA‑48, this position researches, works on, or has access to critical infrastructure and requires the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the university infrastructure. The position requires personnel to be routinely reviewed to determine whether a criminal history or continuous connections to a foreign adversary might prevent the employee from maintaining the security or integrity of the infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Unlocks and locks doors and checks all floors for unsecured doors.
  • Monitors entry into the building and maintains sign‑in/out log.
  • Monitors security cameras and radio traffic; alerts proper personnel of camera malfunctions.
  • Answers the telephone and greets visitors; provides information and directions.
  • Provides immediate contact with the university's police department in case of an emergency; prepares incident reports.
  • May accept parcel packages and deliver them to designated floors or staff.
  • May monitor and control entry into a gated parking lot.
  • Patrols assigned areas to check for criminal activity, rule violations, and irregularities.
  • Performs other job‑related duties assigned.

M&Q: Requires a basic knowledge of grammar, spelling, punctuation, and simple mathematical functions such as percentages and ratios. This may normally be acquired through a high school diploma or GED.

No experience is required.

Requires a valid Texas Driver's License.

Requirements

  • Must be able to work nights, weekends, and overtime assignments.
  • Must be proficient with using a computer and Microsoft Office suite.
  • Must pass a Criminal History and valid TX Driver’s License check prior to an interview.
  • Must pass Background Investigation prior to employment.
  • Must pass a pre‑employment drug screening.

UHPD requires all applicants to complete the criminal history fields on their application. Applicants with incomplete criminal history fields will not be considered for a position.

Required information includes:

  • DOB
  • Driver’s license
  • Last 4 digits of SSN

Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply and will receive preference in employment over other applicants for the same position who do not have a greater qualification. Military experience will only be considered if it includes Military Police or Security‑related responsibilities in your job functions. (Please attach a copy of your DD‑214.)

Salary will be based on years of experience.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (accrual increases with service years)
  • Sick leave accrual
  • Comprehensive free medical coverage for employees (premiums apply for family members)
  • Great optional benefits to enhance your medical coverage
  • Many on‑campus / off‑campus employee perks

Physical & Environmental Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job and are not meant to be all inclusive. While performing this job the staff member shall:

Environmental: The employee may be exposed to inclement weather conditions and has extensive public contact with student, faculty, and staff.

Employees are required to work various assigned shifts, including days, evenings, nights, and weekends, and may be required to remain at their post for an additional shift. All staff are essential personnel and are required to report to work during inclement weather.

Physical: Primary functions require sufficient physical ability to work in a law‑enforcement setting and an office setting; restrain or subdue individuals; walk, stand, sit, or run for extended periods of time; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; occasionally climb and balance; ability to operate and use specialized law‑enforcement tools and equipment.

All positions at the University of Houston‑System are security‑sensitive and will require a criminal history check.

The University of Houston System and its universities are Equal Opportunity Institutions. Everyone is encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Job Post Summary

Date posted: September 12, 2025
Pay: $14.00 per hour with growth to earn more

Job Type: Full-time & part time

Schedule:

  • Time 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM (40 hours per week)
  • Consistent overnight schedule
  • Additional hours available if desired

Job Description

UpScale Security Services is hiring reliable and professional Unarmed Night Shift Security Guards for apartment communities in Houston & Surrounding Areas

These are standing post assignments focused on keeping residential properties safe, secure, and well-maintained during overnight hours. Officers will perform patrols, monitor for suspicious activity, secure amenities, and complete detailed electronic reports before the end of each shift.

Guards may be assigned to either property based on availability and client needs both sites are within the Houston metro area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a high-visibility presence throughout the property at night
  • Conduct routine patrols of parking lots, stairwells, and community areas
  • Ensure pools, gyms, and clubhouses are closed and secured after hours
  • Watch for trespassers, noise disturbances, or suspicious activity
  • Report any maintenance or safety issues (lighting, gates, etc.)
  • Complete clear, detailed electronic shift reports via the company’s app
  • Communicate professionally with residents and property staff

Requirements

  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Active Texas Level II (Unarmed) Security License required
  • U.S. Citizen or valid Work Authorization
  • Must pass background check and drug screening
  • Ability to stand and patrol for full 8-hour shifts
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Why Join UpScale Security?

  • $14/hr starting pay (based on experience & site)
  • Bi-weekly pay
  • Consistent overnight schedule
  • Opportunities for overtime & career advancement
  • Professional, team-focused environment

Benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Work with a rapidly growing security company
